purpose: Exact-hash Workstream 11 motion/reduced-motion browser evidence handoff to Workstream 10 after the Quest MutationObserver feedback-loop fix. This supplements, and does not replace, prior provenance in docs/preproduction/workstreams/11-motion-browser-evidence-20260922.json.
sourceCommitMessage: motion: stop Quest feedback observer churn

liveAuthority.note: Catalog fallback-art release blockers are outside Workstream 11 and remain unwaived.

hashBinding.reuseRule: Reuse this browser evidence only while src/motionGameFeelRuntime.js remains 3c940e0eec7e490544502947fcf2f3cee71076ea and src/motionGameFeel.css remains d8797842f969973f81af2c56ec44d63ea54480ba. A changed motion hash requires fresh targeted evidence.

freshReproducibleFix.symptom: Quest wrong/retry click dispatched a trusted click event and then the browser event loop stopped making progress while class MutationRecords repeatedly accumulated on feedback/question state.
freshReproducibleFix.rootCause: The non-correct celebrateFeedback path performed DOMTokenList.remove writes even when sbMotionCorrect and sbMotionStaticCue were already absent. Browser no-op class mutations can still emit MutationRecords and feed observer-driven runtimes indefinitely.
freshReproducibleFix.fix: Guard both class removals with classList.contains before mutating. No gameplay, answer semantics, persistence, economy, learning state, Store logic, or reduced-motion visual contract changed.
freshReproducibleFix.regressionTest: The motion test now observes an already-cleared wrong/clue state and requires zero class mutations from celebrateFeedback.

persistenceBrowserQa.interpretation: The previously repeated current-day Quest click timeout is cleared on the exact fixed motion runtime.

catalogMobileQa.environment: Playwright 1.55 Chromium headless on GitHub Actions ubuntu-24.04; browser emulation, not physical-device or screen-reader evidence.

storeObserverDiagnostic.interpretation: The fixed Quest observer behavior does not regress the previously closed Store observer/event-loop hang.

handoff.reuse: Use the exact-head browser results above for the bound runtime/CSS hashes; do not rerun the Store hang investigation unless a fresh current-byte failure reproduces or the bound motion hashes change.
